orientation_sensitive_equivalence_geomet.description: Formal scaffold for the geometry of orientation-sensitive equivalence classes.
core_principles: Orientation operator -(i) provides a secondary refinement layer for reconstruction preimages.
Orientation-splitting occurs when histories with identical metric traces have distinct orientation states.
Orientation-erasing occurs when operator-induced loss destroys orientation information.

refinement_classes.name: orientation_preserving_equivalence
refinement_classes.description: Histories remain indistinguishable even under orientation refinement.
refinement_classes.condition: Shared orientation history across all members of the metric equivalence class.

refinement_classes.name: orientation_splitting_equivalence
refinement_classes.description: History indistinguishable by metrics is split into sub-classes by orientation state.
refinement_classes.condition: Metric class contains preimages with divergent -(i) signatures.

refinement_classes.name: orientation_erasing_projection
refinement_classes.description: Orientation information is lost at the projection boundary.
refinement_classes.impact: Collapses orientation-distinct preimages into a single null class.

refinement_classes.name: orientation_smearing_transport
refinement_classes.description: Non-local aggregation erases granular orientation data.
refinement_classes.impact: Averages -(i) contributions over the CSI interaction domain.
